title: Degreewise short exactness of the concrete Mayer-Vietoris complex
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U,V opens covering X, I a cochain complex of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and n an integer such that I.X n is injective. Then the evaluation at n of the concrete short complex schemeMayerVietorisComplex X U V I [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data] is short exact. No injectivity is assumed in other degrees.

proof.text: Evaluate the concrete complex in degree n and identify its maps with the restriction and difference maps on sections over test opens.
Use sheaf gluing for the kernel and injective restriction surjectivity for the cokernel, then transport the sectionwise result to sheaves.
